title: Week 43: Low Water, Hot Chips, Working Agents
summary: Record-low water on the Rhine and rail works squeeze freight into Germany and Switzerland, while carriers return to Suez and Hormuz stays almost shut. Cisco puts a number on its demand-planning agent, AI data centres compete for chips and air cargo, and DSV, Kuehne+Nagel and Meds report on network changes. Plus SAP and Pigment, EU trade defences against China, and the events ahead.
